name: curl in base image below 8.4.0 (CVE-2023-38545 class)
description: curl versions below 8.4.0 are affected by the SOCKS5 heap buffer overflow and related issues.
rationale: Widely-deployed outbound HTTP tooling with a heap-memory-corruption CVE. NIST CM-2 includes the container base image in the authoritative baseline configuration; SI-2 requires timely flaw remediation; RA-5 requires ongoing vulnerability monitoring. PCI DSS 6.3.3 requires critical patches within one month.
